image_manifest.description: The Marine Reptile Racing Referee judging a tie from the water.

assets.name: Referee Character
assets.description: The younger male paleontologist referee (from 'dino_racer_referee_1') wearing the same black-and-white striped jersey over a high-tech wetsuit, with his scuba mask pushed up onto his forehead and his signature thin-rimmed black circular glasses. He is waist-deep in the water, leaning forward with a relieved expression, holding two small silver trophies, one in each hand.

assets.name: Ocean Environment
assets.description: Refractive turquoise water surface, with subtle splash effects around the referee's waist, confirming he is positioned in the seaway.

image_manifest.constraints: NO cables or circles. Referee must be in the water. 1:1 square aspect ratio; no negative space, borders, or title bars.
